changelog: This unit's update source was still pointing at a retired test address, which is why it showed version 11 and reported it as the latest. It has been repointed at the live update service. Please restart Home Assistant (Settings > System > Restart), then press Check for Update again -- the latest version will be offered.
details: test-branch rescue release: repoints CYTECH_MANIFEST_URL from .../ComfortHA-yaml/test/manifest.json to .../main/manifest.json (backup .cytech_secrets.bak_pre_v12_rescue). Ships first_boot.sh (repairs at boot) and cytech_check_only.sh (repairs on Check for Update) so either owner action unblocks the unit. Deliberately no git_tag and no dashboard JSONs: the on-disk update script then falls back to the branch URL, and no Core restart or dashboard write is triggered. Units on /main never see this manifest.
